name: reactor-mode-4d-atb-command
description: #130: Cloud's ATB gauge in the first guard battle. From "battle" (600 frames into it), 300 frames with no input so the gauge fills, mark "full"; then Circle every 20 frames for 240 frames (Attack, then the default target: a command is taken), mark "taken", then 90 frames with no input. Each candidate must read lower at the end than at "full" (*_drop -1: the command emptied the gauge) and higher than at "taken" (*_rise 1: it fills again): turn[0].atbGauge at g_BattleWork base 0x800F5BB8 (b8) and 0x800F5BBC (bc), and g_ActiveCharacters[0].atbTimer (+0x18, act). Signs only. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
